name: Brahma Temple
town_description: Sirsa is a city in northwestern Haryana on the banks of the Ghaggar river, about 250 km from Delhi and Chandigarh. An ancient settlement once known as Sairishaka, it is a commercial and agricultural hub of the region, known for temples, gurdwaras and the Dera Sacha Sauda headquarters.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, about 250 km; Chandigarh Airport is a similar distance.
travel.railway: Sirsa railway station is the nearest station, about 0.9 km from the temple (per map listings).
travel.road: Shri Gaushala Mohalla (listed also as Patel Nagar), Sirsa 125055; local transport from Sirsa bus stand or railway station.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented anywhere - verify locally before visiting.
